author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A painting by Wassily Kandinsky, titled Das bunte Leben, sold at auction for £31.56 million. This artwork was returned to the heirs of its original Jewish owners after decades of dispute. The piece was originally painted in 1907 and displayed at notable exhibitions. Following its theft by the Nazis, it changed hands multiple times before being held by a German bank.
title: Nazi-looted Kandinsky returned to Jewish heirs sells for £31.56m

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Jio IPO: The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start, with institutional investors typically placing their bids closer to the closing deadline. By comparison, the National Stock Exchange of India's share sale recently attracted subscriptions for just 42% of the shares on offer on its first day
title: Jio IPO fully subscribed in just 100 minutes of opening

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Shreyas Iyer has suggested that young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might need to be patient regarding his opportunities in the playing XI. With seasoned openers like Abhishek Sharma and Sanju Samson in fine form, Iyer believes that the experience Sooryavanshi gained from prior tours will significantly aid his growth. He stressed the importance of nurturing a comfortable team atmosphere for the player's continued development.
title: 'Can't walk in right now': Iyer says Sooryavanshi has 'years to get opportunities'

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Under income tax law, SBI staff are treated as non-government employees and, therefore, can claim leave encashment exemption subject to the applicable limit. A retired SBI employee from Jaipur, was unaware of this distinction. When he retired in 2020 he received Rs 9.29 lakh as leave encashment and did not pay tax on the amount.
title: Taxman caps SBI retiree’s leave exemption at Rs 3 lakh; but ITAT grants full relief

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: At least two construction workers were injured in an explosion at a building site in Bengaluru. The incident occurred on Jarmia Road and has raised security concerns. Following the explosion, officials from various divisions inspected the site to assess potential risks. The injured workers were admitted to Bowring Hospital for medical treatment. An investigation is underway to determine the cause of the explosion.
title: 2 injured in explosion at under-construction building in Bengaluru

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Leaders from Congress, TMC, and NCP have voiced strong disapproval of Hardeep Singh Puri for his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein. Puri has contended that his interactions came during a professional delegation after his ambassadorial tenure. Critics are calling for clarification about the substance of these encounters, emphasizing their concerns over the ramifications of Puri's associations with someone linked to serious criminal charges.
title: 'Damning photos': Oppn targets Hardeep Puri's 'private meeting' pic with Epstein

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: 'Human rights not tool for political pressure': India on UN criticism over protests

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: Donald Trump has proposed that large data centres should generate their own electricity and sell surplus power. He emphasized the potential for lower electricity prices through this model for local communities and the grid. Companies are encouraged to provide financial benefits to increase acceptance of data centre projects. Trump has linked the expansion of these centres to competition with China in artificial intelligence.
title: 'Pay community dividend': Trump's message to companies building massive data centres

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Temba Bavuma achieved his highest Test score of 179, helping South Africa recover from a challenging position. The captain's performance was vital as the team declared at 425-9 after being down 110-6. Marco Jansen supported Bavuma with a significant 85 runs, and Simon Harmer contributed 82 runs. The innings included impressive partnerships that shifted the momentum in favor of South Africa.
title: Bavuma enters record books with captain’s knock as SA produce great fightback

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The rupee opened higher against the US dollar, appreciating by 29 paise to a solid 94.62, fueled by foreign investments linked to the Jio IPO and backing from the Reserve Bank of India. Nevertheless, persistent crude oil price surges presented ongoing challenges for the currency. The domestic equity landscape also showed positivity, with the BSE Sensex recording substantial gains, even as foreign institutional investors stayed in a selling position.
title: Rupee gains 29 paise against dollar in early trade, but crude prices limit gains

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.
title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Das, Ranka transferred to Crime Branch

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: By 2027, big tech companies are projected to invest more than $1 trillion in AI infrastructure, fueled by soaring demand. This surge in investment is anticipated to enhance the US economy, potentially adding about 0.75 percentage points to GDP growth. Still, firms are grappling with mounting cash flow pressures and declining bond demand.
title: AI boom set to push Big Tech investment beyond $1 trillion in 2027, says UBS

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In Uttar Pradesh, women are being empowered to transform dried water hyacinth into beautiful handcrafted products. This initiative not only cultivates valuable skills but also enables them to generate income while remaining in their communities. Under the guidance of designer Anurag Gupta, these talented artisans showcased their sustainable fashion creations at Lakmé Fashion Week, highlighting their remarkable craftsmanship.
title: UP village women turn water hyacinth into fashion for Lakmé Fashion Week

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: 'Troubling pattern': UN experts flag 'use of excessive force' during India protests

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: US President Donald Trump has declined to endorse Vice President JD Vance for the 2028 presidential election. While Vance expects Trump's support if he runs, Trump did not commit to backing him. Trump stated there are many capable individuals who could succeed him in the future. Vance acknowledged he hadn't discussed his candidacy directly with Trump. Both their remarks highlight the uncertain nature of the upcoming Republican nomination contest.
title: Who is next Republican nominee for US Prez? Vance expects endorsement; Trump says 'no'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers. By creating essential connections between artisans and American consumers through community initiatives, Rai envisions a future where these artisans can thrive through digital platforms, enhancing cultural heritage while empowering youth in entrepreneurship and leadership roles.
title: Indian-origin teen Dev Rai's nonprofit helps 400+ artisans, sells 900 products

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Jio Platforms IPO is open for subscription from October 21 to October 23. The company, which houses the telecom and digital businesses of the Mukesh Ambani-led group, plans to issue around 27 crore shares at a price band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. The offering is expected to raise approximately Rs 30,213 crore.
title: Jio IPO: QIB portion fully subscribed at over 2x demand within minutes

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Vijay Sethupathi, an accomplished actor in Tamil cinema, has a significant residence in Chennai valued around Rs 50 crore. He has recently released his film 'Baththa', which has received positive feedback from audiences. Born on January 16, 1978, he worked various jobs before pursuing acting full-time after returning from Dubai. The actor has maintained a low profile regarding his property investments, which are spread across Chennai.
title: Inside Vijay Sethupathi's grand Chennai house worth Rs 50 crore

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'My journey began with Ramleela': Ravi Kishan portrays Ram during Dussehra celebrations

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India won all three medals in the men’s shot put F46 event at the Asian Para Games on Wednesday, with Sachin Sarjerao Khilari taking gold with a Games record. Khilari, a silver medallist at the Paris Paralympics, defended the gold he had won at the previous edition of the Games in China. He produced his best throw of 15.87m with his sixth and final attempt to set a new Games record.
title: Asian Para Games: Sachin wins gold as India sweep all three shot put medals

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'Quiet, quiet, are you a sick person?' Trumps snaps at reporter at White House; watch

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Mohammed Shami is determined to fight for his place in the Indian cricket team. He insists that he remains in peak fitness and continues to focus on domestic cricket. Shami completed the previous domestic season and aims to stay prepared for future series and tournaments. While he welcomed Bhuvneshwar Kumar's return, he voiced concerns about communications with selectors. Shami emphasizes the importance of loyalty and dedication to his team, Bengal.
title: ‘Who will talk to me, and why?’: Shami’s blunt take after selectors overlook him

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a remarkable gesture of generosity, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $1.48 million to the Wilcox Medical Center in Kauaʻi. This donation will be utilized to purchase a mobile MRI unit and a 3D mammography machine, reinforcing their decade-long commitment to enhancing healthcare in the community. Overall, their philanthropy has exceeded $4 million, fundamentally improving access to vital medical resources for local residents.
title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan marks 10 years in Hawaii, donates $1.48m to hospital

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Qualcomm plans to implement global layoffs in response to performance evaluations and organizational needs. CEO Cristiano Amon has stated that job cuts will start in November this year. The company aims to create a stronger performance culture to meet business priorities. Despite recent challenges, Qualcomm expects to achieve growth in non-handset sectors by fiscal 2027.
title: Qualcomm layoffs: CEO says job cuts target areas falling short of expectations

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Harmanpreet Kaur achieved a remarkable performance by scoring 91 runs against Zimbabwe in a recent T20I. Her innings marked a significant comeback after struggling for form in previous matches. She expressed gratitude towards those who supported her during challenging times in her career. After stepping down as captain, she found relief and confidence to enjoy her game once more.
title: Harmanpreet Kaur breaks down on live TV, reveals what has changed

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.
title: Avengers Assemble: From Captain America to Spider-Man, superheroes run wild in France

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: Sunil Gavaskar has provided guidance for Indian batters ahead of the Test series against New Zealand. He emphasized the importance of patience and technique to withstand swing and seam conditions. Gavaskar also mentioned that adjusting to the time difference will benefit the Indian team during the series. He expressed concern about the limited two-Test format and its potential to yield inconclusive results.
title: ‘Play as late as possible’: Gavaskar’s advice to India batters for NZ Tests

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Edwina Barvosa, a professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara, has sued the University of California Regents over alleged gender discrimination, unequal pay and blocked promotions. Her lawsuit claims she earned approximately $2.95 million less in base salary than a male colleague. She is seeking compensation for lost wages, benefits, emotional distress and other damages.
title: UCSB professor sues UC Regents over gender bias, $2.95M gap

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Raji Doshi, a 13-year-old from Farmington, Connecticut, has been named America’s Top Young Scientist after winning the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She received $25,000 for developing ALKACORE, a system combining algae and natural aragonite to help reduce ocean acidification. Her innovation explores ways to remove carbon dioxide from seawater and protect marine ecosystems.
title: 13-year-old CT girl wins $25K as Top Young Scientist for ocean fix

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case regarding the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota. Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in Punjab's Mansa while hosting a Facebook Live session. Following demands from his family, Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann announced the case's transfer to the CBI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah welcomed this decision but criticized the state government for not addressing other drug-related cases.
title: CBI registers FIR in murder of anti-drug activist Jhota, team reaches Punjab

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: After prolonged negotiations, India and the United States are on the verge of solidifying a crucial trade agreement. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted the strategic alignment between the two countries during his visit to India. With a shared sense of optimism, both parties are excited about the latest developments in the Bilateral Trade Agreement discussions.
title: India-US ‘pretty close’ to signing a ‘different kind of deal,’ says Trump

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft recently withdrew from a significant data centre deal with Nscale in the UK, causing disruption. This deal involved leasing Nvidia AI chips and aimed at establishing infrastructure for AI. Nscale now faces challenges in securing alternative power sources and finding new customers. The company's planned US stock market listing may be affected by this setback. Overall, the future of Nscale's Loughton project remains uncertain amid ongoing electricity supply issues.
title: Microsoft says ‘not possible’ to Nscale as UK data centre delays mount

author: ABHINAV GARG
description: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have approached the Delhi High Court to challenge their judicial custody. They were detained after climbing a gate to protest at Jantar Mantar on October 13. The initial five-day custody was followed by a two-day extension, which expires on Wednesday. Their case has been transferred to the Crime Branch for further investigation and handling.
title: CJP's Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka move Delhi HC; cases handed to Crime Branch

author: PRABIN KALITA
description: Paolenmung Thangeo, a 45-year-old Kuki tribesman, was killed by gunmen while collecting bamboo shoots. This incident took place in Kangpokpi, Manipur, amidst rising tensions. His companion managed to escape unharmed during the attack. Just a day earlier, three Meitei villagers were ambushed and killed in the same area. Authorities have begun investigations, resulting in the arrest of three suspects connected to the earlier incident.
title: Day after 3 Meiteis killed, Kuki man shot dead as Manipur violence escalates

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Jio Platforms IPO: The company has fixed the price band at Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. Based on the offer documents, the IPO values the company at around $108 billion. Investors will be able to apply for Jio Platforms shares in lots of 12, or in multiples of 12 shares.
title: Jio IPO opens for subscription: Price band, GMP to brokerage views

author: VIBHOR MOHAN
description: Aam Aadmi Party has alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained at Delhi airport recently. He was held for three hours and subsequently issued a challan of Rs 50,000. AAP officials claim this incident reflects a deliberate attempt to humiliate Mann by the BJP-led central government. The party asserts that this move undermines the dignity of Punjab.
title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann 'detained for 3 hours' at Delhi airport, fined Rs 50k

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: LeBron James has adopted a helicopter for his daily commute to the Philadelphia 76ers from New York City, a move confirmed by NBA commissioner Adam Silver as compliant with league regulations. This travel arrangement is a result of James' collaboration with Fanatics, structured to adhere to NBA rules, ensuring no impact on salary cap terms. Speculation around this perk links to the ties between James and the owner of Fanatics.
title: NBA commissioner Adam Silver responds to LeBron James' Fanatics helicopter deal

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Amar’e Stoudemire has officially completed his training at the Basic Law Enforcement Academy and is ready to embark on a new chapter with the Miami-Dade Schools Police Department. Inspired by his family's legacy in law enforcement, Stoudemire, who retired from the NBA in 2016, also explored international basketball while establishing his own wine brand.
title: Former NBA All-Star Amar'e Stoudemire joins police academy in Florida

author: etimes.in
description: Divya Vinekar's sudden departure was revealed by RJ Rohini Ramnathan via social media, marking an emotional moment for many. Requesting privacy for the grieving family, Ramnathan provided details for the cremation for those eager to honor Vinekar's memory. She graced screens with memorable performances in 'Darlings' and 'Jalsa', known for her professionalism and kindness, and her legacy continues to resonate within the film community.
title: 'Darlings' actor Divya Vinekar passes away

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Income Tax Department reopened a woman’s assessment for assessment year 2015-16, alleging that she had wrongly claimed a Rs 14.70 lakh deduction under Section 54F of the Income Tax Act. The Assessing Officer denied the deduction on the ground that she owned more than one residential house apart from the new asset, and assessed her income at Rs 16,70,500.
title: Woman claims Rs 14.7L home relief; taxman cites multiple homes, why ITAT gave relief

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Oil prices have risen due to growing concerns over disruptions in Middle East supplies and threats to shipping routes. Recent attacks on vessels and infrastructure have heightened worries among traders and analysts. While Brent crude futures climbed to $110.10, WTI crude also saw an increase following previous declines. US officials are working with refiners to address rising fuel prices and shortages.
title: Oil prices today: Brent crude tops $110 as Middle East tensions threaten shipments

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A fragment of a D.B. Cooper hijacking banknote fetched an impressive $134,200 at a Dallas auction. This particular note was part of the $200,000 ransom paid to the infamous hijacker back in 1971. Interestingly, in 1980, a young boy came across a piece of this ransom money at Tena Bar, which was later confirmed as authentic by the FBI.
title: DB Cooper $20 bill found by boy in 1980 sells for $134K at auction

author: TNN
description: In Badesra village, two twin brothers, Vinay and Vishnu Chaudhary, were found murdered on Tuesday morning. Their mother, Preeti, allegedly conspired with her paramour to kill them due to their opposition to her relationship. The police discovered the bodies showing multiple injuries, including slit throats and head wounds. Preeti's 16-year-old son also participated in the crime, supporting his mother.
title: Mother, lover, son kill 13-year-old twins who opposed their relationship

author: TNN
title: Captive-bred GIB released into wild killed by fox

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Simon Harmer made headlines with an impressive 82 in the second Test against Australia, eclipsing the previous record of 76 runs held by Dale Steyn for South African No. 9 batsmen. His performance was vital in rescuing South Africa from a challenging position of 110-6. Partnering with Temba Bavuma, their formidable eighth-wicket alliance totaled 183 runs. South Africa eventually declared at 425-9, while Australia wrapped up Day 3 at 3-1.
title: Dale Steyn’s 18-year-old record falls as Harmer scripts history against Australia

author: AHAMED ALI
description: Hindu residents of Thenur near Madurai offered traditional gifts for the inauguration of a renovated mosque. This event highlighted the communal harmony that exists between the village's Hindu and Muslim communities. Villagers participated in diverse religious practices and shared contributions during various festivals throughout the year. A community feast followed the mosque's inauguration, emphasizing mutual respect and unity.
title: Hindus, Muslims celebrate festivals of both faiths in this Madurai village
